entries.title: Genesis 35:1
segments: ¶Then God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to Bethel and dwell there; and make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother."

entries.title: Genesis 35:2
segments: And Jacob said to his household and to all who [were] with him, "Put away the foreign gods that [are] among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

entries.title: Genesis 35:3
segments: "Then let us arise and go up to Bethel; and I will make an altar there to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and has been with me in the way which I have gone."

entries.title: Genesis 35:4
segments: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods which [were] in their hands, and the earrings which [were] in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the terebinth tree which [was] by Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 35:5
segments: And they journeyed, and the terror of God was upon the cities that [were] all around them, and they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 35:6
segments: ¶So Jacob came to Luz (that [is], Bethel), which [is] in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who [were] with him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:7
segments: And he built an altar there and called the place El Bethel, because there God appeared to him when he fled from the face of his brother.

entries.title: Genesis 35:8
segments: Now Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the terebinth tree. So the name of it was called Allon Bachuth.

entries.title: Genesis 35:9
segments: Then God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Padan Aram, and blessed him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:10
segments: And God said to him, "Your name [is] Jacob; your name shall not be called Jacob anymore, but Israel shall be your name." So He called his name Israel.

entries.title: Genesis 35:11
segments: Also God said to him: "I [am] God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall proceed from you, and kings shall come from your body.

entries.title: Genesis 35:12
segments: "The land which I gave Abraham and Isaac I give to you; and to your descendants after you I give this land."

entries.title: Genesis 35:13
segments: Then God went up from him in the place where He talked with him.

entries.title: Genesis 35:14
segments: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He talked with him, a pillar of stone; and he poured a drink offering on it, and he poured oil on it.

entries.title: Genesis 35:15
segments: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Bethel.

entries.title: Genesis 35:16
segments: ¶Then they journeyed from Bethel. And when there was but a little distance to go to Ephrath, Rachel labored [in childbirth], and she had hard labor.

entries.title: Genesis 35:17
segments: Now it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said to her, "Do not fear; you will have this son also."

entries.title: Genesis 35:18
segments: And so it was, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she called his name Ben-Oni; but his father called him Benjamin.

entries.title: Genesis 35:19
segments: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that [is], Bethlehem).

entries.title: Genesis 35:20
segments: And Jacob set a pillar on her grave, which [is] the pillar of Rachel's grave to this day.

entries.title: Genesis 35:21
segments: ¶Then Israel journeyed and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

entries.title: Genesis 35:22
segments: And it happened, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine; and Israel heard [about it]. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

entries.title: Genesis 35:23
segments: the sons of Leah [were] Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun;

entries.title: Genesis 35:24
segments: the sons of Rachel [were] Joseph and Benjamin;

entries.title: Genesis 35:25
segments: the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant, [were] Dan and Naphtali;

entries.title: Genesis 35:26
segments: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, [were] Gad and Asher. These [were] the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Padan Aram.

entries.title: Genesis 35:27
segments: Then Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, or Kirjath Arba (that [is], Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had dwelt.

entries.title: Genesis 35:28
segments: Now the days of Isaac were one hundred and eighty years.

entries.title: Genesis 35:29
segments: So Isaac breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people, [being] old and full of days. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
